prompt: Two buttons share one ActionListener. Complete actionPerformed so it tells the buttons apart with e.getSource() and keeps the label in the form "a=<n> b=<m>".
explanation: A class can implement ActionListener itself and register the same instance on several buttons -- then one actionPerformed handles every click. The ActionEvent carries the origin of the event: e.getSource() returns the exact component object, so comparing it with == against your button fields identifies the sender. This shared-listener style avoids duplicating near-identical listener code.
hints: The same actionPerformed runs for both buttons; the event object tells you who fired it.
Compare e.getSource() == aButton (reference comparison is correct here).
After updating the right counter, rebuild the whole label text: "a=" + aClicks + " b=" + bClicks.
